SELECT m.tenant_id, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id, m.town_id, m.device_code, m.device_name, sum(m.yesterday_all) AS yesterday_all, sum(m.today_all) AS today_all, sum(m.false_all) AS false_all, sum(m.today_process) AS today_process, sum(m.today_complete) AS today_complete, 0 AS pendding_receive, 0 AS pendding_judged, 0 AS pending_dispatched, 0 AS pedding_disposal, 0 AS pending_approve, 0 AS pendding_Leader_approve, sum(m.overtime) AS overtime, #{handleDateTime} as 'handleDateTime', YEAR ( #{handleDate} ), MONTH ( #{handleDate} ), DAY ( #{handleDate} ), m.app_ver_code,m.warning_source,m.industry_code as industry_code FROM ( SELECT a.tenant_id, IFNULL( a.province_code, 'null' ) AS province_id, IFNULL( a.city_code, 'null' ) AS city_id, IFNULL( a.county_code, 'null' ) AS county_id,IFNULL( a.town_code, 'null' ) AS town_id, a.device_code,a.device_name, IF (DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( #{handleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY ), '%Y-%m-%d' ), 1, 0 ) AS yesterday_all, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = #{handleDate}, 1, 0 ) AS today_all, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = #{handleDate} AND a.judge_result = '0', 1, 0 ) AS false_all, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = #{handleDate} AND ((a.order_status IN ( '1', '2', '3', '4', '5' )AND a.enable_acceptance_mode !='1')OR a.enable_acceptance_mode = '1'), 1, 0 ) AS today_process, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = #{handleDate} AND a.order_status IN ('6','0','7'), 1, 0 ) AS today_complete, IF( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = #{handleDate} AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,a.flow_node_time, NOW()) > a.time_limit AND a.time_limit IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS overtime, a.app_ver_code,a.warning_source,a.industry_code FROM ${tableName} a WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' and a.alarm_time >= #{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.alarm_time <= #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) m GROUP BY m.tenant_id, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id,m.town_id, m.device_code, m.app_ver_code, m.industry_code,m.warning_source

SELECT m.tenant_id, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id, m.town_id, m.device_code, m.device_name, m.alarm_time, 0 AS yesterday_all, sum(m.today_all) AS today_all, sum(m.false_all) AS false_all, sum(m.today_process) AS today_process, sum(m.today_complete) AS today_complete, 0 AS pendding_receive, 0 AS pendding_judged, 0 AS pending_dispatched, 0 AS pedding_disposal, 0 AS pending_approve, 0 AS pendding_Leader_approve, sum(m.overtime) AS overtime, YEAR ( NOW( ) ), MONTH ( NOW( ) ), DAY ( NOW( ) ), NOW( ), NOW( ), m.app_ver_code,m.warning_source,m.industry_code as industry_code FROM ( SELECT a.tenant_id,a.alarm_time, IFNULL( a.province_code, 'null' ) AS province_id, IFNULL( a.city_code, 'null' ) AS city_id, IFNULL( a.county_code, 'null' ) AS county_id,IFNULL( a.town_code, 'null' ) AS town_id, a.device_code,a.device_name, IF (DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY ), '%Y-%m-%d' ), 1, 0 ) AS yesterday_all, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate}, 1, 0 ) AS today_all, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate} AND a.judge_result = '0', 1, 0 ) AS false_all, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate} AND ((a.order_status IN ( '1', '2', '3', '4', '5' )AND a.enable_acceptance_mode !='1')OR a.enable_acceptance_mode = '1'), 1, 0 ) AS today_process, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate} AND a.order_status IN ('6','0','7'), 1, 0 ) AS today_complete, IF( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate} AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,a.flow_node_time, NOW()) > a.time_limit AND a.time_limit IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS overtime, a.app_ver_code,a.warning_source,a.industry_code FROM ${tableName} a WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' ) m GROUP BY m.tenant_id, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id,m.town_id, m.device_code, m.app_ver_code, m.industry_code,m.warning_source,DATE_FORMAT( m.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' )

SELECT m.tenant_id, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id, m.town_id, m.device_code, m.device_name, sum(m.pendding_receive) AS pendding_receive, sum(m.pendding_judged) AS pendding_judged, sum(m.pending_dispatched) AS pending_dispatched, sum(m.pedding_disposal) AS pedding_disposal, sum(m.pending_approve) AS pending_approve, 0 AS pendding_Leader_approve, 0 AS overtime, #{handleDateTime} as 'handleDateTime', m.app_ver_code, m.industry_code, m.warning_source FROM (SELECT a.tenant_id, IFNULL( a.province_code, 'null' ) AS province_id, IFNULL( a.city_code, 'null' ) AS city_id, IFNULL(a.county_code, 'null') AS county_id, IFNULL(a.town_code, 'null') AS town_id, a.device_code,a.device_name, IF(a.order_status = '3', 1, 0) AS pendding_receive, IF(a.order_status = '1', 1, 0) AS pendding_judged, IF(a.order_status = '2', 1, 0) AS pending_dispatched, IF(a.order_status IN ('3', '4'), 1, 0) AS pedding_disposal, IF(a.order_status = '5', 1, 0) AS pending_approve, IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,a.flow_node_time, #{handleDateTime}) > a.time_limit AND a.time_limit IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS overtime, a.app_ver_code, a.industry_code, a.warning_source FROM ${tableName} a WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' AND a.enable_acceptance_mode != '1' AND a.tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND a.tenant_id != '' AND a.tenant_id != 'null' ) m GROUP BY m.tenant_id, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id,m.town_id,m.industry_code, m.device_code, m.app_ver_code,m.warning_source
